title: Inbox
description: Direct messages to your Instagram accounts, read live from Instagram. Reply by hand when an automation is not enough.
noText: A message without text (a photo, a sticker or a shared post).

states.loadFailedDescription: Instagram did not answer. Nothing was changed; try again in a moment.

noChannels.title: Connect an Instagram account first
noChannels.description: The inbox shows the direct messages of a connected account.

reauth.title: @{username} needs reconnecting
reauth.description: Instagram stopped accepting this account's access, so its messages cannot be read. An admin can reconnect it from the channels page.

empty.title: No conversations yet
empty.description: When someone sends @{username} a direct message, or an automation writes to them, the conversation appears here.

noMessages: No messages in this conversation yet.

composer.label: Reply to {name}
composer.hint: Instagram only lets you reply within 24 hours of the person's last message.
composer.windowClosed: {name} wrote more than 24 hours ago, so Instagram does not allow a reply now. You can answer as soon as they write to you again.
